subject.title: Use shared Spark subscription review rails

question: Should this repository authorize CLAWSWEEPER_DISPATCH_TOKEN for pull_request_target events delegated to the pinned dinkuskit/clawsweeper workflow?
rationale: The code makes the handoff deterministic, but accepting a privileged cross-repository secret boundary is an owner security decision rather than a contributor-side correctness choice.

options.title: Approve after scope audit
options.body: Confirm the token is least-privilege and restricted to the immutable relay contract before allowing the shared review route to run.

options.title: Require unprivileged admission
options.body: Redesign the relay so pull_request_target admission does not pass a privileged repository secret to the reusable workflow.
